inputs.text: The real issue isn’t that renters have too many protections; it’s that families are still facing eviction and emergency accommodation while secure housing remains out of reach. Six-year leases from March 1 should be judged by whether they give tenants more stability, not dismissed because they might inconvenience landlords. Pointing to tenancy figures means little if people still cannot count on keeping a home. The government needs to put secure, affordable homes ahead of protecting the market’s convenience—and stop treating housing insecurity as a problem renters should simply navigate.
